description: Construction number N.6474. Preserved at Meknes air base alongside a MiG-17. Distinct from the several cannibalised F-5 hulks recorded elsewhere on the same field which are not displays.
Construction number 1406029 and also carries the code 05. Preserved at Meknes air base. Morocco briefly operated Soviet-supplied MiG-17s in the early 1960s so this is a rare survivor of that period.
Construction number N.6226. Preserved at a second Meknes point about 300 m west of the F-5A and MiG-17 pair.
